name: Café Rio Fire-Grilled Chicken Tacos on Warm Corn Tortillas
brandOrRestaurant: Café Rio Mexican Grill (Utah County / Salt Lake)
whyItWorks: Marinated breast meat grilled over open fire, served in soft warm corn tortillas without greasy frying oil, cheese, or beans. Clean, easily digested protein and gentle gluten-free corn starch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Specify: 2 corn tortillas, grilled chicken only. Skip black/pinto beans, cheese, pico de gallo, and romaine lettuce. Pair with plain white rice.
